---
applyTo: "**/{README,CHANGELOG}.md"
description: "Use when updating README.md or CHANGELOG.md to enforce documentation structure and release-note quality."
---

# Documentation Workflow Rules

- Keep `README.md` concise, accurate, and actionable.
- Keep `CHANGELOG.md` in Keep a Changelog style.
- Ensure an `[Unreleased]` section exists.
- Never remove setup and verification commands from README.
- Keep examples aligned with actual scripts and CI workflows.
